title: Tightened Cavity Initialization 20-Layer Defect-DBR Stack
scientific_hypothesis: Restricting the cavity layer (index 10) initialization to [220, 320] nm will accelerate convergence toward the optimal spectral pitch while maintaining the defect-cavity resonance mechanism that produced the 0.711 target score in prior iterations.
design_principle: Defect-cavity bandpass design with alternating high/low index mirrors surrounding a central half-wave or near-half-wave cavity layer. The cavity creates a transmission peak in the SWIR band while the distributed Bragg reflectors provide UV/blue rejection.
proposed_topology: exactly 20 finite layers from the incident side: HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica

manufacturing_considerations: All thicknesses within practical deposition range 50-800 nm
HfO2/SiO2 material pair compatible with electron-beam or ion-assisted deposition
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for planar multilayer interference
Defect-cavity resonance principle for bandpass filtering
Distributed Bragg reflector theory for broadband rejection
expected_advantages: Faster convergence due to narrowed cavity search space
Preserved mirror optimization freedom for spectral shaping
Builds on verified 0.711 score mechanism from prior iteration
known_risks: Over-constraining cavity may miss global optimum outside [220, 320] nm band
20-layer count may still be suboptimal for dual-band performance
Numerical convergence issues may persist if cavity thickness creates sharp resonances
execution_request_english: Perform one bounded TMM thickness optimization for an exactly 20-layer planar stack. Use the fixed material sequence from the incident side: HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica. Optimize only the physical thickness of each finite layer within the user-declared bounds. Do not optimize material identity or layer count in this route. Optimize a 20-layer defect-cavity dielectric stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Material sequence: SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2(cavity)|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2. All 20 layer thicknesses are optimizable variables. Initialize layer 10 (HfO2 cavity) with uniform random distribution bounded to [220, 320] nm. Initialize all other layers with uniform random distribution bounded to [100, 400] nm. Evaluate spectral performance over 300-450 nm (target: high reflectance) and 1000-1700 nm (target: high transmittance) bands at normal incidence. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with maximum 500 iterations. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates count, tightest_margin, and thicknesses_nm for all candidates. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: reflection in 1000-1700 nm; transmission in 300-450 nm. manufacturing constraints: Maximum total layer count of 30.
revision_reason: Tightened cavity layer 10 initialization bounds from previous broad range to [220, 320] nm based on feedback directive and observed correlation between 250-286 nm cavity values and highest target scores (0.711) in prior iteration batch.
